directory_policies.notes.6: English policy: A recent English exam is required for non-native speakers on the stated visa route, including US-educated applicants. The page does not turn successful-applicant ranges into hard minimums; exact current cutoff reconciliation remains open.

source_excerpt: taken within the last two years
fact_summary: The current MCDS page requires recent English test evidence even for US-educated applicants; it does not set a hard score floor from successful-applicant statistics.
